title: Parmigiana di Melanzane Eggplant

description: Parmigiana di Melanzane is a classic Italian vegetarian dish, featuring layers of tender fried or baked eggplant, rich tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and grated Parmigiano Reggiano cheese. This comforting casserole is baked to golden perfection, offering a symphony of savory flavors and a truly satisfying experience. It is a beloved staple in Italian cuisine, perfect for family meals or special occasions.

ingredients.notes: plus more for frying or baking

instructions.title: Prepare the Eggplant
instructions.text: Slice eggplants into 1/4-inch thick rounds. Lay them on a baking sheet, sprinkle generously with salt, and let them rest for 30 minutes to draw out moisture. Pat them dry thoroughly with paper towels to remove excess salt and moisture.

instructions.title: Make the Tomato Sauce
instructions.text: In a large saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat. Sauté the chopped onion until softened, about 5 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, a pinch of salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened. Stir in fresh basil.

instructions.title: Cook the Eggplant
instructions.text: Heat 1/4 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the dried eggplant slices in batches until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil. Alternatively, brush eggplant with olive oil and bake at 400F (200C) until tender and lightly browned.

instructions.title: Assemble the Parmigiana
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375F (190C). Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange a single layer of cooked eggplant slices over the sauce. Top with a layer of mozzarella cheese, followed by a sprinkle of Parmigiano Reggiano. Repeat these layers two more times, ending with a generous layer of sauce and Parmigiano.

instructions.title: Bake the Parmigiana
instructions.text: Cover the baking dish loosely with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Remove the foil and continue baking for another 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and bubbly. The cheese should be melted and lightly browned.

instructions.title: Rest and Serve
instructions.text: Let the Parmigiana di Melanzane rest for at least 10-15 minutes after removing from the oven. This allows the layers to set and makes for easier serving. Garnish with fresh basil before slicing and serving warm as a main course or a side dish.

tips: To reduce oil and calories, bake the eggplant slices instead of frying. Brush them lightly with olive oil and bake at 400F (200C) until tender and golden.
For an extra rich flavor, make your tomato sauce from scratch with high-quality San Marzano tomatoes. A good quality Parmigiano Reggiano also makes a significant difference.
Parmigiana tastes even better the next day! It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days and reheated gently in the oven or microwave.
